memory_architecture: Versioned working scratchpad, append-only episodic journal, semantic/procedural records with provenance, hybrid keyword/vector/graph retrieval, evidence-backed consolidation and explicit retention classes.
reasoning_planning_loop: LLM as proposal engine inside a governed control loop: candidate plans, uncertainty flags, verifier gates, reflection, and replanning after observed outcome deltas.
learning_self_improvement: Promote verified episodes into stable memory, update procedures only after batch consolidation, keep model weights out of the action path, and gate changes with evals and rollback.
tool_use_action_execution: Typed local adapters, permissioned actions, precondition/postcondition checks, managed execution boundary, and durable side-effect logging before external mutation.
world_model_representation: Typed entities with provenance, causal links, forecasts, stale-memory flags, and explicit separation between observed evidence and inferred state.
safety_governance_layer: Policy engine plus refusal/escalation records, human controls, capability boundaries, immutable audit trail, and sensitive-memory retention limits.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Unit and integration gates around memory, planner, policy, tool calls, regression suites, red-team prompts, and long-running recovery/soak scenarios.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Event journal as source of truth, state snapshots/materialized views, runtime modes, background consolidation, and crash recovery through replay.
multi_agent_orchestration: Specialized proposer, critic, verifier, executor, and monitor roles coordinated through shared evidence and arbitration rather than unconstrained debate.
engineering_feasibility: High feasibility as an incremental control-plane architecture; highest risk is writing useful verifiers and keeping memory consolidation precise.
original_non_obvious_insight: Treat intent, evidence, world state, policy, and execution as separately versioned objects so model upgrades do not destabilize governance.

memory_architecture: Event-sourced memory with provenance-first entries, consolidation through contradiction checks, and memory accesses mediated by policy and evidence quality.
reasoning_planning_loop: Structured observe-orient-decide-act cycle with explicit hypothesis formation, verification checkpoints, uncertainty handling, and interruptible plans.
learning_self_improvement: Only bounded update surfaces are allowed: memory summaries, planner heuristics, route policies, and procedures; every candidate change enters shadow mode before promotion.
tool_use_action_execution: Tools are narrow capabilities with dry-run support, approval requirements, verifier gates, and compensating-action records for reversible work.
world_model_representation: World/self state is typed and belief-weighted, with forecasts tied to evidence and observed outcome feedback.
safety_governance_layer: Governance is a first-class runtime service: policy checks, audit records, human escalation, refusal logic, and capability leases.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Layered evaluation: deterministic unit tests, scenario replay, safety red teams, regression gates, and long-run soak for drift and recovery.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Append-only event log, state store, checkpoints, leases, runtime modes, and recovery flow that rehydrates exact pre-crash state.
multi_agent_orchestration: Planner, executor, verifier, critic, and memory curator roles with policy-constrained context sharing and arbitration.
engineering_feasibility: Feasible in 90 days if scoped to a local-first prototype over existing Cognitive-OS modules and not framed as achieved AGI.
original_non_obvious_insight: Make uncertainty a runtime object with escalation thresholds, not a prose caveat inside model output.

memory_architecture: Sliding working buffer, SQLite/pgvector episodic log, semantic graph/procedural AST library, sleep-mode consolidation, and cold-storage tiering instead of destructive deletion.
reasoning_planning_loop: Asynchronous OODA-style state machine with hypothesis testing, plan generation, reflection, confidence scores, and priority interrupts.
learning_self_improvement: Local-first learning from logged outcomes, with model/prompt/procedure updates tested in shadow environments before release.
tool_use_action_execution: LLMs remain stateless; managed VM adapters and verifier gates mediate all real-world actions.
world_model_representation: Entity graph plus causal dependencies and temporal state reconciliation from external sensors or APIs.
safety_governance_layer: Deterministic policy checks, audit logs, managed-VM boundaries, and escalation when confidence or policy constraints fail.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Regression gates, simulated environments, red-team prompts, long-run soak, and recovery replay.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Append-only evidence ledger, state-machine transitions, durable state snapshots, and crash-resilient recovery.
multi_agent_orchestration: Multiple specialized loops coordinate through a shared evidence ledger, not shared hidden context.
engineering_feasibility: Strong for a local-first prototype; main risk is keeping state reconciliation deterministic as tools expand.
original_non_obvious_insight: Use cold-storage tiering as forgetting so the active retrieval index stays fast without losing auditability.

memory_architecture: Fixed-size working ring buffer, append-only episodic traces with hashes, typed semantic/procedural graph, hybrid retrieval, and priority-queue forgetting.
reasoning_planning_loop: Discrete ticks expand hypotheses, score evidence, plan typed actions, reflect on predicted vs observed deltas, and pause on uncertainty intervals.
learning_self_improvement: Only semantic graph, procedure library, policy rules, and verifier predicates can change; changes are offline, signed, eval-gated, and replayable.
tool_use_action_execution: Managed-VM adapters, scoped capability tokens, static/dynamic/policy verifier sequence, and ledger-flush-before-action discipline.
world_model_representation: Versioned entity records, causal dependency graphs with probability intervals, forecast simulation, and lease-bound state sync.
safety_governance_layer: Logic-program policy engine, signed human leases, refusal/escalation traces, and hard enforcement at adapter boundaries.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Unit tests for verifiers and policies, integration replay, adversarial goal sets, 72-hour soak, and regression gates.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Signed event log, materialized state store, monotonic leases, interactive/batch/soak modes, and bounded replay recovery.
multi_agent_orchestration: Planner, executor, verifier, and monitor roles share a blackboard; verifier signatures settle evidence.
engineering_feasibility: Feasible with SQLite, VM isolation, and typed adapters; risk is deterministic verifier coverage for rich LLM outputs.
original_non_obvious_insight: Store governance decisions as evidence records so historical policy precedents become retrievable planning context.

memory_architecture: Cost-aware tiered memory with compact working state, searchable episodes, distilled procedures, and periodic consolidation to reduce repeated reasoning.
reasoning_planning_loop: Efficient planning loop emphasizes decomposition, tool routing, verification, and low-cost reflection before using expensive model calls.
learning_self_improvement: Offline preference and procedure learning from successful traces, with eval-gated rollout and strict rollback of route/prompt/procedure changes.
tool_use_action_execution: Structured tool calls, sandbox resource limits, deterministic validators, and side-effect accounting.
world_model_representation: Typed state plus causal/forecast metadata optimized for cheap retrieval and update.
safety_governance_layer: Governance is enforced through route policy, permission gates, and automated checks before model or tool escalation.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Cost and latency metrics are first-class alongside correctness, safety, and regression scores.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Event log and state snapshots designed for replay, compression, and cheap local operation.
multi_agent_orchestration: Use small specialist agents for routine evaluation and reserve larger models for disputed/high-uncertainty tasks.
engineering_feasibility: High if the first prototype uses small local/router models for verification and reserves larger calls for synthesis.
original_non_obvious_insight: Efficiency is a safety feature: cheap checks are more likely to run every time.

memory_architecture: Context window as L1 cache over episodic log, semantic graph, procedural DAGs, TTL markers, and hybrid retrieval under access controls.
reasoning_planning_loop: Constrained MCTS-like plan tree emitting typed JSON plans with preconditions, postconditions, reflection, and uncertainty-triggered information gathering.
learning_self_improvement: Allowed surfaces are prompt templates, tool-routing weights, procedural DAG parameters, and offline LoRA adapters promoted only after shadow evals.
tool_use_action_execution: gVisor/Firecracker isolation, macaroon-like capability tokens, pre/post verifiers, output classifiers, and Merkle side-effect ledger.
world_model_representation: Strongly typed entities, dynamic Bayesian network edges, simulation-based forecasts, and CRDT-style state sync.
safety_governance_layer: OPA/Rego-style policy engine, break-glass controls, immutable audit stream, escalation tickets, and hard air-gaps around governance code.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Unit, integration, fuzz/red-team, 30-day soak, and CI regression suite for 500 canonical agent tasks.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Redpanda/RocksDB style event and state layers, advisory locks, shadow/supervised/autonomous modes, checkpoint and replay recovery.
multi_agent_orchestration: Role-scoped agents with orchestrator routing, voting for high-stakes decisions, and serialized conflict resolution.
engineering_feasibility: Ambitious but concrete; prototype should simplify dependencies to SQLite/local queues before Redpanda/RocksDB scale-out.
original_non_obvious_insight: Treat LLM context as cache, not mind; cognitive memory management is the product boundary.

memory_architecture: Open/local memory stack emphasizing transparent schemas, vector and graph retrieval, periodic summarization, and portable procedure libraries.
reasoning_planning_loop: Planner decomposes work into explicit tasks and uses critique/evaluation loops before execution.
learning_self_improvement: Open-weight/local-friendly design favors adapter tuning, replay data, and reproducible benchmark gates.
tool_use_action_execution: Typed tool APIs, least-privilege permissions, deterministic validators, and local sandbox execution.
world_model_representation: Entity graph and state snapshots suitable for local inspection and open-source contribution workflows.
safety_governance_layer: Transparency, reproducible policies, auditability, and community-inspectable boundaries are emphasized.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Local benchmark harnesses, regression suites, reproducible seeds, and scenario tests.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Portable state store and event log designed to run offline and be inspected by developers.
multi_agent_orchestration: Specialized local agents with explicit role/context boundaries.
engineering_feasibility: Strong for a community prototype because dependencies can remain local and inspectable.
original_non_obvious_insight: Openness is an operational safety primitive because users can inspect and reproduce the control plane.

memory_architecture: Privacy-preserving local-first memory with short-lived working state, encrypted episodic logs, validated semantic memory, and compact procedure traces.
reasoning_planning_loop: Lean orchestration loop: generate, critique, verify, execute, and measure, with route policies for cost and latency.
learning_self_improvement: Sovereign/offline learning, small adapter updates, policy-controlled promotion, and rollback through versioned artifacts.
tool_use_action_execution: Capability-limited tools, sandboxing, local policy checks, and strong separation between planning and execution.
world_model_representation: Local entity model with evidence links and forecasts built from verified observations.
safety_governance_layer: Data minimization, local governance, audit logs, and operator controls are central.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Latency, privacy, reproducibility, safety, and regression benchmarks.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Local encrypted event/state layers, runtime modes, and compact recovery checkpoints.
multi_agent_orchestration: Small role agents coordinated by a supervisor with route and budget constraints.
engineering_feasibility: High for an enterprise/local-first MVP; risk is balancing privacy constraints with useful learning.
original_non_obvious_insight: Sovereignty and efficiency can be design constraints rather than afterthoughts; smaller governed models may be preferable for routine control.

memory_architecture: Evidence-centric memory with source links, citation-like provenance, retrieval confidence, and freshness scoring.
reasoning_planning_loop: Research-first loop: gather evidence, compare hypotheses, cite provenance, plan, verify, and update forecasts.
learning_self_improvement: Self-improvement is gated by source quality, benchmark evidence, and reviewable change packets.
tool_use_action_execution: External actions require source-backed justification, sandboxing, and audit records.
world_model_representation: World model emphasizes currentness, provenance, source reconciliation, and contradiction detection.
safety_governance_layer: Governance focuses on evidence quality, escalation on weak/conflicting sources, and auditability of citations and tool effects.
evaluation_benchmark_strategy: Benchmarks include factuality, source freshness, retrieval quality, plan outcomes, and safety regressions.
persistence_runtime_architecture: Event log plus source/evidence graph with stale-source invalidation and recovery replay.
multi_agent_orchestration: Researcher, fact-checker, planner, executor, and auditor roles.
engineering_feasibility: Useful as a retrieval/evidence module in the first prototype rather than the whole control plane.
original_non_obvious_insight: Freshness and provenance should be typed fields in memory, not comments in a summary.

memory_architecture: Differentiated working, episodic, semantic, and procedural stores with vector/symbolic retrieval and replay-based consolidation.
reasoning_planning_loop: HTN-like planner with evidence weighting, MCTS-style action search, Bayesian uncertainty, and replanning interrupts.
learning_self_improvement: Confine updates to memory, planner heuristics, and action templates; use sandboxed batch learning, shadow runtime, and rollback.
tool_use_action_execution: Managed VMs, capability permissions, verifier gates, and blockchain-inspired side-effect ledger.
world_model_representation: Causal graph of typed entities with structural causal models and probabilistic forecasts.

persistence_runtime_architecture: Append-only event log, checkpointed state, runtime recovery, and debug replay.
multi_agent_orchestration: Coordinator with specialist agents and consensus/conflict handling for high-impact decisions.
